message.content:
This portrait-oriented editorial illustration features a magazine cover titled "TEMPO" in large white letters. The artwork depicts three people viewed from behind, wearing gray jackets with a "KPK" logo on the back. One person on the left raises their hands, while another on the right holds up a smartphone. They stand in an urban environment facing a massive, three-legged machine with a broad, disc-shaped head and two glowing white spots resembling eyes. This tripod-like machine towers over a large, curved building labeled "KPK" and a pedestrian overpass.

The sky is a hazy, light gray color. Bold, black text across the center reads "SERANGAN ANGKET DARI SENAYAN". At the top, text mentions "INVESTIGASI: LUBANG MAUT SISA TAMBANG" and "KISAH WARTAWAN YANG DISEKAP DI GUANTANAMO". The bottom left corner contains a barcode and text reading "8-14 MEI 2017" and "RP 45.000". A thick red border runs along the left edge. The overall color palette is muted, primarily consisting of grays, blacks, and whites.
